name: components/item
description: Composable row primitive for list items, menu rows, contacts, media entries, and settings-style layouts.
useCases: Contact and team member rows with avatar, title, description, and actions
Clickable navigation rows and settings entries with leading icons or trailing controls
Media, product, and notification list items with consistent spacing
Dropdown menu rows and grouped item sections
usage: import { Item, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemMedia, ItemActions } from "shadcn-solid-components/components/item"
